story: Homolovi Ruins State Park is located in Arizona, United States, preserving over 300 Ancestral Puebloan archaeological sites. The park is situated on a floodplain of the Little Colorado River and features seven separate pueblo ruins built between approximately 1260 and 1400.
matters: This fertile area preserves ancestral Hopi villages that are considered spiritually alive. The park also provides habitat for a bird checklist of over 100 species, including hawks and golden eagles.
name: Homolovi Ruins State Park
